entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to an agent.
Thanks for holding. You're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. Just need the shipping label.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your order, could I please get your name?
Jane Smith. The item is a ClubFit Jersey.
Thank you, Jane. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered about 51 days ago. Can you tell me what the issue is with the jersey?
It's the wrong size. It's way too tight and I never wore it. I just want to return it.
I understand. Not a problem at all. You are well within our 90-day return policy for standard items. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to do an exchange for a larger size?
A refund is fine. Just send the label to my email.

Absolutely. I have just processed that for you. The prepaid return label is on its way to your inbox now. Also, I see you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you, I've added a free express shipping voucher to your account for your next order.
Okay, fine. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome, Jane. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
